update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.2 - Changelog
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Hokko Tarumae 2026-10-24`. - Make the Trackblazer Shop faster. The bot reads item names in one pass on the way down, then buys on the way back up instead of returning to the top first. It also waits for item animations and dialogs to finish instead of using fixed delays. - Give list scans up to 2 minutes before timing out, so long late-game skill lists are read in full. - Retry dropped GameTora event requests when updating game data.
Fixes --- - Fix the Trackblazer Shop passing over a fresh copy of an item that was already bought earlier, leaving its coins unspent. - Fix the Trackblazer Shop missing the last item in the list when a NEW badge sits on it. - Fix the Race History scan skipping rows. - Fix the Skill List mistaking a double circle skill for its single circle version, which overspent the skill point plan. - Fix a crash on the "A Pleasant Practice Partner?" event.
